steps.title: Initialize Project & Layout Structure
steps.description: Set up HTML5 skeleton, Tailwind CSS v4 via CDN, Google Fonts, and FontAwesome icons.

steps.title: Configure Navigation & Hero Section
steps.description: Create responsive sticky navbar with mobile menu toggle and an immersive hero section with quick booking CTA.

steps.title: Build About Us & Story Section
steps.description: Add brand story, craftsmanship highlights, and high-quality imagery grid.

steps.title: Implement Services & Pricing Menu
steps.description: Design sleek service categories (Haircut, Beard Trim, Hot Towel Shave, VIP Packages) with dynamic pricing.

steps.title: Build Master Barbers Showcase
steps.description: Create professional barber cards featuring bios, specialties, and direct booking triggers.

steps.title: Implement Gallery with Filter Tabs
steps.description: Showcase haircut styles and salon interior with responsive grid and category filtering.

steps.title: Build Customer Testimonials & Reviews Carousel
steps.description: Create interactive testimonial cards highlighting client satisfaction and reviews.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Online Booking System
steps.description: Implement multi-step appointment scheduler (Service -> Barber -> Date/Time -> Customer Details).

steps.title: Build Backend API Client & Auth Integration
steps.description: Connect booking system to TrumpleDroid backend for authenticated client appointments storage.

steps.title: Implement Client Portal & Appointment History
steps.description: Allow logged-in users to view, manage, and cancel their upcoming appointments.

steps.title: Design Footer & Location Map Widget
steps.description: Add operating hours, contact info, interactive Leaflet map integration, and newsletter subscription.

steps.title: Add Authentication Modals (Login/Signup/Forgot Password)
steps.description: Create sleek modal overlays for user registration, login, and OTP password recovery.

steps.title: Refine UI Polish, Animations & Responsiveness
steps.description: Add smooth scrolling, hover effects, modal handlers, and ensure mobile responsiveness.

steps.title: Building barberlanding
steps.description: Finalize all components, verify API contracts, and perform final build check.
